findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe archive extraction
 * @description Archive extraction without path validation
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-archive-extraction
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode extractCall
where
  (
    extractCall = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember("open").getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall() or
    extractCall = API::moduleImport("zipfile").getMember("ZipFile").getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall()
  )
select extractCall, "Archive extraction may be vulnerable to path traversal attacks."
findings.hypothesis: Archive extraction operations without proper path validation could allow path traversal attacks

message.text: Archive extraction may be vulnerable to path traversal attacks.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command injection via subprocess
 * @description Using subprocess with shell=True and untrusted input can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection-subprocess
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall()
  ) and
  (
    // Check for shell=True
    exists(DataFlow::Node shellArg |
      shellArg = call.getArgByName("shell") and
      shellArg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
    )
    or
    // os.system always uses shell
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe command execution with shell=True or os.system."
findings.hypothesis: Command injection through subprocess calls with shell=True or os.system

message.text: Potentially unsafe command execution with shell=True or os.system.

import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve"]).getACall() or

    call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "request"]).getACall() or

  )

/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization using pickle, marshal, shelve, or yaml.load
